needs.premise: Atomic origin/locator transaction, pinned route, externally established frozen source/child/admin receipts; bounded histories and sampling, not exhaustive or C/unload/liveness proof.
Selective locator, resident epoch, reader, admin, child and fixed-budget laws; not complete QNT induction or source/C refinement.

Generated caller already holds bounded origin slot/generation, complete mapped source and durable bind serial; no origin discovered by FP/thread ID/callsite; initial entry/host permits must be separately admitted.

Same control transaction reserves canonical cell and publishes recoverable locator into fixed origin journal before effects; Binding retains source; retry follows locator and never creates another cell; child retains parent journal.
Anchor persists outside GSTATE teardown; check slot/session/VM generation before reading VM pointer; lifetime pin before dereference; fixed VM capacity and checked counters, no historical VM map.
Offline/Starting/Online/Quiescing/Detached; consume session even on setup failure; repeated live setup rejects; status drain allowed while new effects close; detach before reader-safe free.
Real cleanup calls current_vm_resize(false,1); dedicated per-VM administrative credit must survive ordinary window exhaustion; unknown shrink/child results retain debt and resumable cleanup state.

Concrete C journal commit and recovery, router/session pin vs removal, domain effect gate recheck, root scanner publication and lock hierarchy; arbitrary owner-stop/torn stores require explicit receipts.
Every issued sequence reserves a physical slot; terminal out-of-order settlement stays a bitmap bit; advance only over exact settled head. Ghost history is not physical storage.

Arena/bitmap/exit/result and source handle capacity precede publication; before reserve failure caller retains full mapped frame; after publish core settlement allocates nothing and VM exit escrow is already reserved.
Separate terminal result ACK, extra source lease ACK, physical scanner/borrower drain, control pins and producer seal. Key-only delayed envelopes may outlive record; no borrowed payload pointer may.
Actual selected CFUN lacks cleanup body; outer run/call catcher and native guard must transfer source view/key and close future publication before unwind; dynamic-wind alone is insufficient.

Reacquire logical frame and current slot after relocation/restoration; distinguish same-live-native invocation from fresh Scheme reinvocation and unwound C activation; continuation/denv writers remain a premise.

Separate prepared capacity, stable routing descriptors, bound native children and committed collector members. Current processor_count drives barrier and GC partitioning; changing it needs a real generation transition, not a renamed scalar.

Registry close and root acceptance linearize in one domain; frozen complete caller view covers closed-round deferral. Snapshot membership and relocation exclusion cannot be inferred from release/acquire alone.
